To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
during synaptogenesis, the GA becomes compartmentalized into two distinct domains, and that this compartmentalization is maintained throughout adult life, and is under nerve control.
in innervate adult skeletal muscle, the GA is compartmentalized, and that the organization of the secretoray pathway is placed under the control of the nerve endings.
the organization of the secreted pathway is modified during synaptogenesis and that this process depends on nerve control.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the organization of the secretor pathway in the muscle fiber.
the organization of membrane traffic in muscle fibers and its regulation by nerve activity.
the developmental regulation and functional significance of the subsynaptically located GA in innervated skeletal muscle.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
in innervating muscle fibers, the GA becomes highly compartmentalized and functionally specialized in a subsynaptic region.
in innervate muscle fibers the GA is a dynamic organelle whose distribution and composition are regulated by the innervation.
in the developing innervated fiber a specific organization of the secretor pathway takes place in the subsynapse.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GA is remodeled during development in order to become a specialized secretory compartment, and this specialization is under nerve control.
, during development and in the adult, the secretory pathway of the muscle fiber is organized in such a way that it is able to respond to nerve signals.
the nerve controls the organization of the secreted proteins and their targeting to the synapse.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GA of the innervated muscle fiber is organized in two compartments.
the organization of the secretor pathway is a highly regulated event that is controlled by the innervation of the muscle fibers.
, in innervated skeletal muscle, the GA is remodeled shortly after the onset on innervation and that this remodelling is maintained in the adult.
